title: Apply for a corporation property licence
summary: Learn about and apply for a corporation property licence if your corporation conducts business in real estate, stock and station, or strata management.
intro:
If your corporation wants to conduct business in real estate, stock and station or strata management, it will need a corporation property licence.

You can submit and pay for your corporation’s application online.
who_can_apply: Must be a director or company secretary.
Must have at least one director who holds an individual property licence.
Must have a nominated licensee in charge who holds a class 1 licence.
Must have a registered office in NSW (or within 50 kilometres of the NSW border if the licensee holds a current licence or authority from that jurisdiction).
what_you_need: Business name registration from ASIC (if applicable).
One form of identification for each company director.
A person who has a class 1 property licence to be nominated as the licensee in charge of the business.
Notification of partnership particulars form (PDF, if applicable).
Licensee in Charge Details (PDF, if applicable).

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for a property licence.

more_info.text: A corporation property licence is issued for 1, 3 or 5 years and can be renewed.

faqs.q: Who needs a corporation property licence?
faqs.a: A corporation needs this licence if it plans to conduct business in real estate, stock and station, or strata management.

faqs.q: What are the requirements to apply for the licence?
faqs.a: To apply, the applicant must be either a director or company secretary, have at least one director who holds an individual property licence, and have a nominated licensee in charge who holds a class 1 licence. The corporation must also have a registered office in NSW.

faqs.q: How can I apply for the licence?
faqs.a: You can apply online by selecting the 'Apply online' button and following the prompts.
